info.name: M10 Data & Compliance API
info.description:
Complete API collection for M10 Data & Compliance module.

Base URL: http://localhost:4011
All routes under: /api/v1/m10-data-compliance

Dev Auth (M10_STANDALONE_AUTH=true) — only these two headers needed:
  x-tenant-id: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
  x-user-id:   00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002

─── Frontend: M10-frontend (Next.js, port 3000) ─────────────────────
Proxy: /api/v1/m10-data-compliance/* → http://localhost:4011/*
API client: src/features/data-cloud/services/apiClient.ts
Main view: src/features/data-cloud/DataCloudManagerView.tsx

All 9 frontend endpoints are in the '🚀 Frontend Flow' folder.
Run them top-to-bottom in Postman Runner for a full integration test.

item.name: 🚀 Frontend Flow (DataCloudManagerView)
item.description:
These are the exact 9 endpoints called by the M10-frontend (DataCloudManagerView.tsx / apiClient.ts).
Run top-to-bottom. Test scripts auto-capture IDs into collection variables.

Request bodies match the frontend's exact payload shapes.

request.description: Frontend calls this on mount to verify the API is reachable.

Frontend normalises each item via normaliseConnection(raw):
  raw.connectionId → id
  raw.destination  → type (snowflake|postgres|redshift|bigquery|s3|databricks)
  raw.destinationName → name
  raw.isActive     → CONNECTED / DISCONNECTED
  raw.config.host, .database, .schema, .username
  raw.createdAt    → lastSynced

Frontend payload shape (from apiClient.ts createConnection):
  destination: 'postgres' | 'snowflake' | 'bigquery' | 's3' | 'databricks' | 'redshift'
  destinationName: string
  config: { host, database, schema, username }

Response fields used by frontend: connectionId, destination, destinationName, isActive, config, createdAt

Frontend reads: { success: boolean, message: string }
Called from handleTestConnection() in DataCloudManagerView.

Frontend normalises via normaliseExportRun(raw):
  raw.runId → id
  raw.connectionId
  raw.destination → tableName
  raw.status → RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILED
  raw.rowsExported → recordsExported
  raw.filePaths (object keys = dataset names)
  raw.startedAt, raw.completedAt, raw.errorMessage, raw.downloadUrls

Frontend constructs this URL via downloadExportRun(runId, dataset, format).
Returns raw file stream (text/csv or application/octet-stream).

Frontend normalises via normalisePolicy(raw):
  raw.id
  raw.name → ruleName
  raw.description → details
  raw.channel → appliedTo
  raw.regionFamily → appliedTo (fallback)
  raw.isActive + raw.ruleDefinition.fallbackAction → COMPLIANT / WARNING
  raw.createdAt / raw.updatedAt → checkedAt

Frontend payload shape (from apiClient.ts createDataCompliance):
  name: string
  description: string
  channel: 'email' | 'call' | 'sms' | 'data_export'
  regionFamily: 'GLOBAL'  ← frontend always sends GLOBAL
  ruleDefinition: { fallbackAction: 'allow' | 'block' }

Note: frontend does NOT send requireExplicitConsent.

Frontend calls getCrmSyncStatus() which hits this endpoint with limit=1
as a lightweight health-check only. The response body is NOT read — the
frontend returns its own mocked sync-status with the current timestamp.

Frontend payload shape (from apiClient.ts replaySync):
  connectionId: UUID  ← set by collection variable from step 2 or 3
  datasetName: 'accounts' (frontend default)
  windowStart: ISO8601
  windowEnd: ISO8601

Frontend reads: { message: string }

item.name: M10 Base Controller (api/v1/data-compliance)
item.description:
Legacy base controller at the shorter path /api/v1/data-compliance (no 'm10-' prefix).
Source: m10.controller.ts — M10DataComplianceController
Currently returns mock data. Used as a lightweight generic compliance record interface.

request.description:
Handler: findAll(tenantId)
Returns: [{ message: 'Mock list for tenant <id>' }]
Note: path is /api/v1/data-compliance — NOT /api/v1/m10-data-compliance

Handler: create(dto, tenantId)
Publishes 'compliance.policy.updated' event after creation.
Returns: { id: 'mock-id-123', ...dto, tenantId }
Note: path is /api/v1/data-compliance — NOT /api/v1/m10-data-compliance
Verifies the API is running. No DB call.
Verifies database connectivity by running a lightweight Prisma query.
Seeds the DB with demo tenant + accounts/deals. Useful for populating the frontend.

channel: email | call | sms | data_export
regionFamily: GDPR | CCPA | GLOBAL
fallbackAction: allow | block
Soft-deactivates the policy (sets isActive=false). Does NOT hard-delete the row.

source: web_form | manual_crm | opt_in_email | api
status: granted | revoked
Immutable evaluation decision log. Filter by email, decision (allow|block).

Runtime compliance gate called before email/call/SMS.
Returns: { decision: 'allow'|'block', reasonCode, correlationId }

Reason codes:
  POLICY_PASSED | CRM_OPTED_OUT | SUPPRESSED | GDPR_CONSENT_REQUIRED
  CCPA_RESTRICTED | GDPR_ERASURE_IN_PROGRESS | EPRIVACY_CONSENT_REQUIRED
  FAIL_CLOSED_MISSING_DATA | NO_ACTIVE_POLICY
Will block if no GDPR consent record exists for this EU contact.
Returns: { success: boolean, message: string }
datasetName: accounts | contacts | deals | activities
Returns raw file stream. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman to save the file.
requestType: erasure | portability | access | rectification
status: pending | in_progress | completed | rejected
Returns portable data package for the given contact email.

purpose: marketing | tracking | essential
source: cookie_banner | preference_center
status: granted | revoked
reason: global_dnc | eprivacy_revoke | spam_complaint
